2	import { balanceDue } from './payments.js';

4	/**
5	 * Get all invoices that are overdue as of a given date.
6	 * @param {Array<{ number: string, customerId: string, status: string, dueDate: string, lines: Array, payments?: Array<{ amount: number, date: string }> }>} invoices
7	 * @param {string} asOf - YYYY-MM-DD format, cutoff date
8	 * @returns {Array<{ number: string, customerId: string, dueDate: string, daysOverdue: number, due: number }>} sorted by daysOverdue descending (most overdue first)
9	 */
10	export function overdueInvoices(invoices, asOf) {
11	  return invoices
12	    .filter((inv) => (inv.status === 'issued' || inv.status === 'partially_paid'))
13	    .filter((inv) => inv.dueDate < asOf)
14	    .map((inv) => ({
15	      number: inv.number,
16	      customerId: inv.customerId,
17	      dueDate: inv.dueDate,
18	      daysOverdue: daysBetween(inv.dueDate, asOf),
19	      due: balanceDue(inv),
20	    }))
21	    .sort((a, b) => b.daysOverdue - a.daysOverdue);
22	}
